provenance.source: Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits (Alpaydin & Kaynak, 1998), UCI Machine Learning Repository; the 1 797-sample test set bundled with scikit-learn 1.7.2
provenance.citation: Alpaydin, E. & Kaynak, C. (1998). Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C50P49
provenance.featureDescription: 64 features: 32×32 bitmaps divided into non-overlapping 4×4 blocks; each feature counts the 'on' pixels in a block (integer 0–16), giving an 8×8 image.
provenance.preprocessing: None beyond the original block counting.
